title: Review as Code Feedback Thread
description: Optional machine-readable projection of a RaC feedback thread, derived per SPEC Section 18.1. Markdown remains the canonical human-readable format. Additional properties are permitted at the thread level so repositories MAY extend threads.

kind.description: Recommended kinds from SPEC Section 8.5: Clarification, Response, Report, Confirmation. Repositories MAY use other values.

author_role.description: Recommended roles from SPEC Section 8.5: Reviewer, Implementer, Verifier. Repositories MAY extend the role vocabulary.

author.description: Optional author identity alongside the role.
